text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right after the race—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uuuu~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I loooost~~~!
Waaahhhhhh~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, Trainerrr...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was no good after all.
But I wanted to win so badly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is genuinely frustrated.
Precisely because she gave her absolute all in a brutal race, the sting of defeat runs deep. But—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right.
There's still the Winning Live. The fans are waiting."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's gonna go dance.
As an umadol, with a smile!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wiping away her tears, Smart Falcon took the stage for the Winning Live.
Her performance before the packed crowd was truly breathtaking—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So this is... the top stage...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was the best~~~!
Congratulatiooooons~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to stand there...!
Up on that stage...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, I have to stand up.
Next time, Falco is definitely—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon returned after finishing the concert.
Her expression was even brighter than before she went on stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Falco sang her heart out!
choice_data_list: How was the view from the top?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that alone won't get the point across, will it?
But how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, it's so blindingly bright!
Everyone's penlights, the spotlights, everything in front of me is sparkling and shining..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"—I couldn't help thinking how happy I'd be
if all that light belonged to Falco."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Trainer!
Falco wants to stand on top of the stage again!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Next time—to the top stage of dirt racing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"At the dirt Winning Live,
I want to create a view filled with all those lights."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because when that time comes,
Falco will definitely be singing at the center!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Performing on the stage of a Classic race Winning Live
seems to have deepened her desire
to become the 'Top Umadol on Dirt'."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Falco wants to challenge a dirt GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I need to shed the 'rookie' title already.
In Umadol terms, it's time to take the next step.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I think that means a GⅠ... stepping onto a grand stage and making a name nationwide!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in GⅠ races
just like the Satsuki Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the result this time was unfortunate, her ability
on dirt is undeniable. It's more than enough for GⅠ races
packed with heavyweights. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the Satsuki Sho, it's a race that can only
be challenged during the Classic Year.
I truly want her to seize victory in it now."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me!
Or rather, any GⅠ race works for me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"There aren't that many Dirt GⅠs anyway...
so I'm entering every single stage I can stand on!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Japan Dirt Derby!
Time to take on the top of the dirt division~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next goal was set: the Japan Dirt Derby!
